description:
### Kizu 2.0.0

**New Features**

- Added a Player Controls settings tab.
- Added an option to hide the Create Clip button in the player.
- Added an option to hide the Cast button in the player.
- Added an option to hide the Live Share controls in the player.
- Added a landscape brightness gesture.
- Added a landscape volume gesture.

**Fixes & Improvements**

- Improved compatibility between player gestures and the video quality menu.
- Fixed scrolling conflicts between the video quality menu and player gestures.
- Improved touch handling in the regular and full-screen players.
